# Stand-in pages for tests/den-public-worker.mjs

Every page here is invented. The session that built release 7 had no network route to any site, so nothing could be
saved from a real public page; these mimic the shape such pages usually have (labelled dates, a status line, a list of
headlines, a signature count). `DEN.md` s.8 lists the first live sweep that must prove each real address. No client
material, no real person.
